retrieved.title: 实验室与机房的真实感

request:
镜头 s06：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 9 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-lab50s）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Super 16', 'Vision3 500T']）：Locked look "2050s institute film archive" (style preset sp01-lab50s): an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera; Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop; a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8; filter none; grade: muted, desaturated, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical; light: cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows; texture: lively Super 16 grain, slightly soft resolution; the institute's own observational record, watching people work from across the room.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：固定机位，缓慢推近。深夜的实验室，宋工一个人坐在台灯下，把女儿的蜡笔画用胶带贴在新笔记本的第一页，用手掌抚平，抬头隔着玻璃看了一眼机房里那枚红色镜头。环境声：机房的低频嗡鸣、撕胶带的声音。
情绪：quiet, solitary, contemplative
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, tripod camera with one slow push in
景深与虚实：Focus on Song and the notebook; the server hall behind the glass is soft, the red lens a glowing blurred point.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Night in the institute laboratory: Song sits alone at the long cluttered workbench under a desk lamp, taping the child's crayon drawing onto the first page of an open hardback notebook; behind him a large glass wall shows the cold server hall and the single red-glowing lens on the central black cabinet. Blocking lock: Song sits at the workbench at frame left under the desk lamp, the notebook in front of him; the glass wall fills the right half of the frame with the server hall and the red lens glowing at frame right.
Picture 2: Engineer Song (Song Qi, 33 in 2048, systems engineer on the 550 quantum-computer project) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 33-year-old Chinese man, systems engineer on a national quantum-computer project. Slim, medium height, short neat black hair with a side parting, clean-shaven, a small mole under his right eye, warm attentive eyes with faint laugh lines, thin round steel-rimmed glasses. Light-grey knitted cardigan over a pale blue collared work shirt, a blank white ID card on a dark lanyard, a cheap black digital wristwatch on his left wrist.
Picture 3: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
Picture 4: MOSS terminal (black AI terminal with one red glowing lens) (character reference; role: the central AI's physical presence). Close view of an artificial-intelligence monitoring terminal built into a brushed-steel wall panel of a control hall: a black glass housing with a single round camera lens glowing deep red in its centre, a thin ring of red light around it, faint reflections of people in the glass. Cold, clinical, perfectly clean in contrast with the worn surroundings.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：low hum of the server hall, the rip of tape, a desk lamp buzzing faintly
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/tex-lab] 实验室与机房的真实感
[rules/move/locked-off] move
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 9.0s, 24fps, locked look "2050s institute film archive": an Arriflex 416 Super 16 camera with a 12-120mm documentary zoom at f/2.8, Kodak Vision3 500T 7219 pushed one stop, filter none, muted desaturated grade with a green-cyan fluorescent cast and one warm practical, cold fluorescent tubes plus one warm desk lamp, deep shadows, lively Super 16 grain and slightly soft resolution; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium shot on a locked-off tripod camera with one very slow push in from medium shot to medium close-up, ending framed on Song's hands and face at frame left with the glass wall still filling frame right. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Song seated at frame left at the long workbench under the warm desk lamp, the open notebook directly in front of him, both hands at the page; the glass wall fills the right half of frame, the server hall soft beyond it and the red lens glowing at frame right. Start: his right hand lifts a short strip of yellowed tape from the bench edge and presses one end onto the notebook's first page, the drawing already laid in place; the tape lifts a little at one corner and he presses it again. Middle: he sets the tape roll down, lays his open palm flat on the page and draws it slowly from the centre outward, once, smoothing the paper and the tape down, his fingertips dragging slightly on the paper; the wristwatch catches the lamp light. End: his palm stays flat on the page, he lifts his chin and turns his head a little toward frame right, looking through the glass at the red lens; his eyes stay on it, his shoulders settle, and he holds that look without moving. Mood: quiet, solitary, contemplative. Blur: Song's face, glasses, hands and the notebook page stay sharp; the server hall behind the glass is soft, the red lens a glowing blurred point at frame right, and the bench clutter in the foreground falls gently out of focus. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

Low hum of the server hall through the glass, the rip of tape from the roll, the faint buzz of the desk lamp, a soft paper rustle as the palm smooths the page, a quiet creak of the chair, the brush of the cardigan sleeve on the bench, distant cooling fans; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
